villain_conquest.interaction: Interact with summoning circle at marked designated points to summon villains
villain_conquest.point_limit: Maximum 1 Mechadrake Point per team per match
villain_conquest.activation_requirement: Collect 3 Mechadrake Points to qualify for Mechadrake Trial

mechadrake_trial.activation: Requires 3 Mechadrake Points. If 1 team member has 3 points, the whole squad activates it in BR-Ranked on Bermuda map
mechadrake_trial.victory_condition: Achieve Booyah in Mechadrake Trial to enter Mechadrake War after match
mechadrake_trial.success_reward: Extra rank points upon defeating Mechadrake; Mechadrake Points reset to 0
mechadrake_trial.failure_penalty: Failing to Booyah deducts 1 Mechadrake Point
mechadrake_trial.in_trial_villain: Defeating a villain during trial still awards 1 Mechadrake Point

vending_machines.price_adjustments: General price tweaks applied across other shop items

portal_go.energizer_interaction: Usage of Energizer is non-interruptible during teleportation

airdrop_adjustments.monster_truck_airdrop: Light effect indicator on the ground has been removed
